subject.title: Rename i18n locale codes from region-based (zh-CN/zh-TW) to script-based (zh-Hans/zh-Hant)

question: Should OpenClaw change the canonical Chinese locale IDs from `zh-CN`/`zh-TW` to `zh-Hans`/`zh-Hant` across Control UI, CLI wizard, docs publish metadata, generated i18n assets, tests, docs, and saved preferences?
rationale: The rename is semantically reasonable but it changes public locale values and persisted/browser-visible behavior, so automation should not choose the permanent product contract or migration compatibility policy.

options.title: Approve coordinated script-ID migration
options.body: Migrate runtime, wizard, docs publish metadata, generated i18n assets, tests, docs, and saved browser preferences together in one compatibility-aware change.

options.title: Keep current region IDs
options.body: Treat `zh-CN` and `zh-TW` as OpenClaw's stable user-facing locale contract while continuing terminology improvements under those IDs.

options.title: Defer to broader i18n planning
options.body: Keep the issue open as backlog until maintainers settle the long-term localization contract and docs publish shape.

recommendation.title: Approve coordinated script-ID migration
recommendation.body: Migrate runtime, wizard, docs publish metadata, generated i18n assets, tests, docs, and saved browser preferences together in one compatibility-aware change.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans the CLI wizard locale contract and public docs surfaces where `steipete` has recent merged ownership signals and would be the best available coordinator.
